name: Labelhai Beteiligung
personality: Only takes a modest percentage of everything that might happen.
visual_intent: Record Label Shark metaphor: broad square low ink splat,tiny dark burgundy lapel panels and gold tiepin,small fin-shaped lapel badge NOT shark body,ONE little golden record with missing wedge held beside closed contract folio. Unequal heavy lids,closed toothless predatory smirk
biography: Only takes a modest percentage of everything that might happen. His HyperNorm record promises ownership of every possible future success. A dissonant card asks why the missing wedge is called a modest share. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Beteiligung betrifft nur das eventuell noch Kommende.

name: Sternchen Einmalnoch
personality: Would like the next song to introduce her to the first one's audience.
visual_intent: One-Hit Wonder: tall narrow pear ink blob,small teal sparkly cap,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE little gold single-record medal on SHORT ribbon and old-fashioned handheld microphone. Huge anxious unequal eyes,closed nervous toothless zigzag smile
biography: Would like the next song to introduce her to the first one's audience. Her HyperNorm medal identifies her so completely that nobody hears the next song. A dissonant card asks her to sing something unfinished. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die nächste Gelegenheit wird am ersten Erfolg gemessen.

name: Sänger Tonrichtig
personality: Hits every approved note without finding where he left the feeling.
visual_intent: Autotune Robot Singer interpreted organic ink: round top-heavy blob,small copper headset with tiny antenna ABOVE unobscured eyes,chrome bowtie,ONE chunky retro microphone with ONE simple tuning dial on handle. Ecstatic crooked open singing grin with THREE upper teeth,no robot body/metal face
biography: Hits every approved note without finding where he left the feeling. His dial tunes HyperNorm feeling to the approved interval. A dissonant card holds one wavering note long enough for someone to recognize it. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Ton ist richtig. Die Empfindung wird nachgeregelt.

name: Fan Doppelsigniert
personality: Is perfectly happy to be nobody important in two separate queues.
visual_intent: Groupie Pair metaphor ONE actor: lean hooked comma blob,soft rust music cap,ONE fan of TWO blank autograph cards and TWO bright wristbands on own goo wrists,tiny folded scarf. Huge starstruck uneven eyes,tiny toothless open triangular mouth,no second fan or photo faces
biography: Is perfectly happy to be nobody important in two separate queues. His HyperNorm wristbands admit him to two versions of the same wait. A dissonant card asks what he loves when nobody famous is looking. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bedeutungslosigkeit verfügt bereits über zwei Zugangsberechtigungen.

name: Roadie Tragfähig
personality: Carries the sound of everybody else's freedom.
visual_intent: Roadie with Amp: squat broad asymmetrical splat,little dark work cap,goggles parked high,two lashes,tiny canvas bib patch,ONE compact scuffed amplifier with visible speaker grille and coiled SHORT cable held at flank. Extremely tired unequal lids,deep closed toothless pout,body not hidden
biography: Carries the sound of everybody else's freedom. Her amplifier carries every HyperNorm demand for effortless expression. A dissonant card stays behind to help her lift it. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Freiheit der anderen wurde transportgerecht verpackt.

name: Anwalt Kleingedruckt
personality: Can make an excellent opportunity fit inside a remarkably small exception.
visual_intent: Contract Fine-Print Lawyer: tall top-heavy lopsided blob,small plum legal cap,small cream collar,ONE tiny folded contract with only abstract tiny marks and oversized magnifying glass held low clear of eyes. Delighted asymmetric open grin with TWO upper teeth,one raised calculating brow
biography: Can make an excellent opportunity fit inside a remarkably small exception. His magnifier finds the HyperNorm exception that swallows the promise. A dissonant card reads the sentence aloud at an inconveniently ordinary speed. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Gelegenheit passt vollständig in ihren Ausschluss.
